final.narration: Published flows appear to be running about 7% too low across recent field checks. Because this exceeds the gauge's normal scatter of 4.8%, it is worth watching rather than assuming nothing is wrong. Routine site visits show no structural problems or shifts in the riverbed, so the station remains dependable overall. Continue using the published data for regular operations, but review the next field measurement to see if this slight drift persists. Trust score 94/100 (Trusted).
